<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* This really isn’t turning out as planned. I’ve still a
long way to go before I can replicate that special soup...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! Thanks for asking,
pumpkin!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>I’m talking about my favorite special soup! The sweet-
and-sour flavor just can’t be beat!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! You’re quite right,
pumpkin!

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>The special soup I’m thinking of is truly an exquisite dish!
The sweet-and-sour flavor just can’t be beat!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>My buddy used to make it for me back in the day, and I’ve
been trying to recreate it...<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,4)> No matter how many times
I try, though, the flavor’s not quite right.

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Maybe I should use the same kind of kitchen as my buddy?
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>But there’s no way I could find—

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>You’d really do that for me, dumpling?! Well, I certainly
won’t say no!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I think my buddy’s kitchen looked something like this...

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>The <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2075)> is the most important part!
Using it makes any sort of stewed dish <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,8)><$kfacial(2)>SO much more
delicious!
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>I’ll be waiting, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Would you make me a kitchen like the one my buddy
used, please?

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you made me the
kitchen!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,10)>I’ll get right down to cooking!
Burble, burble, burble away, simmer all that soup... ♪

<$voicel(2,9)>Thanks to your help, sweet pea, it’s at least looking a lot
closer to the soup I remember! <$voicel(2,8)><$facial(2,14)><$kfacial(2)>Now for the taste test...

<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,5)>I mean, it’s tasty enough as it is, but it’s just...not quite the
flavor I was looking for. There’s something missing!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,10)>But what in the world could that missing ingredient be?!

<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)><$pkcry;0(2,1)>... I wish I could savor it once more...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,2)>That special soup...
<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, hello, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>Thanks for asking, pumpkin! I’m talking about a soup my
buddy used to make me. <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>The sweet-and-sour flavor can’t
be beat!

<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,9)>You’re very right! My buddy used to make it for me, and
let me tell you, if you tasted that sweet-and-sour soup,
you’d never forget it!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>I think I’m going to give it a go making it myself! Now that
you’ve made me such a lovely kitchen,
<$cdef(27)>,
<$voicel(2,8)>I think
I
can
recreate
that soup!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,9)>After all, the kitchen looks JUST like my buddy’s! So I’ll
get started cooking right away!
Burble, burble, burble away, simmer all that soup... ♪
<$comeff(2,10)><$voicel(2,9)>Aaand, it’s finished! Now for the taste test...

<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,5)>I mean, it’s tasty enough as it is, but it’s just...not quite the
flavor I was looking for. There’s something missing!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,10)>But what in the world could that missing ingredient be?!

<$emotion(2,18)><$voicel(2,3)>*sigh* So even the perfect kitchen’s not enough... What
in the world could be missing?!

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Since I’ve got the right tools, it must be the ingredients.
Do you think there’s a missing secret ingredient?

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>... ... ...
Ahhh, but I can’t imagine what! I’m a failure as a chef...

<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,2)>Hmmm... <$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,7)>Maybe my buddy’s book could help? They were
always writing stuff down in it!

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,5)>What was so special about scribbling down all those
little symbols? <$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,8)>Humans are so odd...

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Still, I suppose it could provide a hint... Now, let’s see...
Where did they put it?

<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)><$cdef(27)>! Would you help me search for
my
buddy’s
book,
honey bun?

The book <$cdef(27)><$cname(216)> is looking for must be somewhere in
this town.
In fact, it may be closer than you think! Find the book and
bring it to them!

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,5)>Could you please help me find the book my buddy was
always writing in?

The book <$cdef(27)><$cname(216)> is looking for must be somewhere in
this town.
In fact, it may be closer than you think! Find the book and
bring it to them!

Hm? There’s a photo tucked in the diary. It’s a picture of
<$cdef(27)>Chef Dente right after eating a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(63)>. They
have a rather strained expression on their face.

Could <$cdef(27)><$ifull(63)> be the secret ingredient? Go to
<$cdef(27)>Chef Dente and find out!

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, dumpling, you found my
buddy’s
book!
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>Now
let’s see...

<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>...Oh, dear. I don’t understand a thing. What about
you, <$cdef(27)>?

<$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,7)>Hm? This is a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(63)>. These things are incredibly
bitter! <$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,6)>There’s no way they’d be in that special sweet-and-
sour sou—

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,7)>No...wait. My buddy taught me <$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>that cooking is all about
making brave decisions!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>So let’s give it a try! And maybe this time...
Burble, burble, burble away, simmer all that soup... ♪
<$voicel(2,10)>And now...time to eat!

<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>... ... ...
This sweet-and-sour taste... This rich flavor...
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>THIS is it! This tastes JUST like my buddy’s special soup!

<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>I NEVER would have suspected that the secret ingredient
was <$cdef(27)><$ifull(63)>, of all things!
<$emotion(2,38)><$voicel(2,10)>I’m really not a fan of those berries usually, so color me
surprised that they were in my favorite food all along!

<$emotion(2,14)><$voicel(2,5)>Come to think of it... My buddy <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,8)>did really seem to want
me to eat <$cdef(27)><$ifull(63)>.
<$voicel(2,3)>Maybe they were trying to help me learn to be less picky.

<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Hee hee! At any rate, it’s thanks to you that I was able to
recreate the soup, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Thank you SO much, dumpling!

<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,7)>I’ll keep cooking up a storm until the day I get to see my
buddy again!
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmm... I can’t make it here.

<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,664)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh, well you see, there’s a certain dish I’d really like to
make! But to do that, first I’d like to <$voicel(2,5)>go back
to <$cdef(27)><$stgname;0(3)>.

<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Do you think you could take me there whenever you’re
free, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,7)>Could you take me back to <$cdef(27)><$stgname;1(3)></color>?

<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Thanks for bringing me back! I should be able to make
it here...
